review_method: Read all 9 composition HTML files, extracted and visually inspected real exported frames at 960x540 playback scale.

findings.issue: Category descriptions have inconsistent line counts and apparent alignment because Act copy wraps after physical while peer columns are one line.
findings.recommendation: Use equal-size, equal-baseline concise one-line descriptions in three aligned columns.

findings.issue: Continuous contact breaks into two lines while Path accuracy and Actual trace are one line.
findings.recommendation: Reduce the three item text sizes consistently enough that all three phrases stay on one line; retain independent panel title size.

findings.issue: Execute the sequence and Key response observed wrap into two small lines, unlike Blue demonstration. The small mono notes become dense at 960px playback.
findings.recommendation: Keep Observe/Replay headings and evidence timings. Shorten notes to Replay sequence and Key response; do not add success/completion claims.

passed: Intro/outro bitmap wordmarks align and omit the colon.
Mind and Mind2Act case main titles fit a single line within safe margins.
15-task wall uses consistently aligned category headings, fixed card geometry, and no overflowing names; some intended names use two lines.
Coordination final triangle has aligned Mind/Act category/caption baselines.
Difficulty comparison headings, cells, and row labels align; CP02 text uses an intentional two-line phrase, no clipping.
Statistics numeral and explanation form a clear two-part hierarchy.
Outro invitation, actions, and URL are centered with no clipping.
limitations: Static typography review cannot by itself verify all motion. Arrow tracing and montage sequencing delegated separately. Final exported revision must be reviewed independently.
